notes: 冲突备份补齐：拉取冲突时「本机版」和「云端版」两份都存进备份目录（本机-Local / 云端-Cloud），备份目录名与其中的「说明-README.txt」用中英双语写明生成时间、仓库、同步前 HEAD、云端 ref 与 sha、条目数与两个目录各是什么；云端副本走 git cat-file blob 按字节原样落盘，.zstd/.tgz 不会被转码，两侧都做字节校验。面板展开后有两个按钮「还原本机副本」「还原云端副本」，两份都能单独写回工作区、互不覆盖，哪一份没备份成功对应按钮即置灰；还原目标取清单里记录的仓库路径，事后改过 repoPath 也不会写错仓库。
notesEn: Conflict backups completed: a pull conflict now saves BOTH sides — the local copy (本机-Local) and the cloud copy (云端-Cloud) — and the backup folder plus its 说明-README.txt describe, in Chinese and English, when it was created, the repo, HEAD before the pull, the remote ref and sha, the item count and what each folder holds. Cloud copies are written byte-exact through git cat-file blob, so .zstd/.tgz binaries are never re-encoded, and both sides are size-verified. Each expanded row now has "Restore local copy" and "Restore cloud copy"; either copy can be written back independently, the buttons are greyed out when that side failed to save, and the restore target comes from the repo recorded in the list, so a later repoPath change cannot point it at the wrong repo.
